title: One-Compartment IV Bolus Population PK
description: Single-compartment intravenous bolus pharmacokinetic control stream (ADVAN1 TRANS2) estimating clearance and central volume with proportional residual error.
code:
$PROBLEM One-Compartment IV Bolus Population PK Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV EVID
$DATA iv_1cmt.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN1 TRANS2
$PK
  CL = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1))
  V  = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2))
  S1 = V
$ERROR
  IPRED = F
  Y = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1))
$THETA
  (0, 4.5, 50.0)   ; CL (L/h)
  (0, 35.0, 200.0) ; V (L)
$OMEGA
  0.04 ; IIV_CL
  0.04 ; IIV_V
$SIGMA
  0.01 ; RUV_PROP
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=500 RATE=0 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=0 ADDL=0

title: One-Compartment Oral First-Order Absorption (Theophylline)
description: Classic one-compartment oral absorption population PK model (ADVAN2 TRANS2) for theophylline with first-order absorption rate KA, clearance CL, and volume V.
code:
$PROBLEM Theophylline One-Compartment Oral First-Order Absorption PK
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV CMT EVID
$DATA theophylline.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2
$PK
  KA = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1))
  CL = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2))
  V  = THETA(3) * EXP(ETA(3))
  S2 = V
$ERROR
  IPRED = F
  Y = IPRED + EPS(1)
$THETA
  (0, 1.5, 10.0)   ; KA (1/h)
  (0, 2.8, 25.0)   ; CL (L/h)
  (0, 32.0, 150.0) ; V (L)
$OMEGA
  0.09 ; IIV_KA
  0.04 ; IIV_CL
  0.04 ; IIV_V
$SIGMA
  0.25 ; RUV_ADD
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=320 RATE=0 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=0 ADDL=0

title: Two-Compartment IV Infusion Population PK
description: Two-compartment linear pharmacokinetic model (ADVAN3 TRANS4) with constant-rate intravenous infusion, inter-compartmental clearance Q, and combined error model.
code:
$PROBLEM Two-Compartment IV Infusion Population PK Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT RATE DV CMT EVID
$DATA infusion.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN3 TRANS4
$PK
  CL = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1))
  V1 = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2))
  Q  = THETA(3)
  V2 = THETA(4)
  S1 = V1
$ERROR
  IPRED = F
  W = IPRED * 0.1
  Y = IPRED + W * EPS(1)
$THETA
  (0, 6.0, 60.0)   ; CL (L/h)
  (0, 18.0, 150.0) ; V1 (L)
  (0, 5.0, 50.0)   ; Q (L/h)
  (0, 45.0, 300.0) ; V2 (L)
$OMEGA
  0.05 ; IIV_CL
  0.04 ; IIV_V1
$SIGMA
  0.01 ; RUV_PROP
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=1000 RATE=500 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=12 ADDL=1

title: Covariate-Adjusted Allometric Pediatric Clearance Model
description: Two-compartment oral population PK model (ADVAN4 TRANS4) incorporating allometric body-weight scaling on clearance and central volume for pediatric dosing.
code:
$PROBLEM Allometric Weight Covariate Two-Compartment Oral PK Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV CMT EVID WT
$DATA pediatric_pk.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN4 TRANS4
$PK
  TVCL = THETA(1) * (WT / 70.0)**0.75
  TVV2 = THETA(2) * (WT / 70.0)
  CL = TVCL * EXP(ETA(1))
  V2 = TVV2 * EXP(ETA(2))
  Q  = THETA(3)
  V3 = THETA(4)
  KA = THETA(5)
  S2 = V2
$ERROR
  IPRED = F
  W = IPRED * 0.1
  Y = IPRED + W * EPS(1)
$THETA
  (0, 5.2, 50.0)   ; CL_70kg (L/h)
  (0, 24.0, 200.0) ; V2_70kg (L)
  (0, 3.8, 40.0)   ; Q (L/h)
  (0, 42.0, 400.0) ; V3 (L)
  (0, 1.3, 10.0)   ; KA (1/h)
$OMEGA
  0.04 ; IIV_CL
  0.04 ; IIV_V2
$SIGMA
  0.01 ; RUV_PROP
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT POSTHOC
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=150 RATE=0 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=12 ADDL=2

title: Joint PK/PD Indirect-Response Biomarker Model
description: Custom $DES nonlinear ODE system (ADVAN6) coupling oral drug absorption and plasma kinetics with an Emax-inhibited indirect-response pharmacodynamic biomarker.
code:
$PROBLEM Joint Oral PK and Indirect-Response PD Biomarker Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV CMT EVID
$DATA clinical_trial.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN6 TOL=6
$MODEL NCOMPARTMENTS=3 COMP=(DEPOT DEFDOSE) COMP=(CENTRAL DEFOBS) COMP=(BIOMARKER)
$PK
  KA   = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1))
  CL   = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2))
  V    = THETA(3)
  KIN  = THETA(4)
  KOUT = THETA(5)
  IC50 = THETA(6)
  K    = CL / V
  S2   = V
$DES
  CONC    = A(2) / V
  INH     = CONC / (IC50 + CONC)
  DADT(1) = -KA * A(1)
  DADT(2) = KA * A(1) - K * A(2)
  DADT(3) = KIN * (1.0 - INH) - KOUT * A(3)
$ERROR
  IPRED = A(2) / V
  Y = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1))
$THETA
  (0, 1.1, 10.0)   ; KA (1/h)
  (0, 4.2, 40.0)   ; CL (L/h)
  (0, 25.0, 200.0) ; V (L)
  (0, 10.0, 100.0) ; KIN (U/h)
  (0, 0.10, 2.0)   ; KOUT (1/h)
  (0, 1.5, 50.0)   ; IC50 (mg/L)
$OMEGA
  0.06 ; IIV_KA
  0.04 ; IIV_CL
$SIGMA
  0.01 ; RUV_PROP
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=200 RATE=0 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=24 ADDL=2
